prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY Xiaoshang Bridge 小商桥 in Linying, Henan, a short historic open-spandrel stone arch bridge. Photo 2 is the best SIDE GEOMETRY reference for the arches, although its right end is cropped; photo 3 shows the COMPLETE bridge and its railings from above and must supply the full uncropped ends. Draw a nearly straight-on SIDE ELEVATION, with just a slight view of the roadway and far parapet. Exactly THREE arched openings: ONE broad shallow segmental main arch in the center and ONE smaller semicircular spandrel arch to its LEFT and ONE smaller semicircular spandrel arch to its RIGHT. This is NOT Zhaozhou Bridge: do NOT draw two small arches on each side. Preserve the low almost-level roadway, red stone voussoir shape and rows of upright parapet posts with rectangular stone panels. Retain only a few simplified lion or rounded post caps, a small central carved keystone motif and two or three relief panel indications. Include both complete bridge ends, no large modern embankments. All arch voids, water and stone surfaces remain WHITE, using contour lines only. Sparse stone joints to explain arch construction, no dense masonry or paving grid, no hatching. A few short thin water-level strokes may meet the foot of the main arch; no reflections, river texture or landscape. Remove trees, people, signs, modern metal rails, wires and watermark. Whole bridge occupies 80 percent canvas width with both ends and all three arch openings clear, landscape 1536x1024.

historical_sources.title: 许昌学院中原农耕文化博物馆：风雨沧桑小商桥
historical_sources.supports: 茅以升与罗哲文断代意见、现桥形制尺寸、1994—1995 年修缮及历代构件

site_recommendation.name: 小商桥
site_recommendation.era: 宋代主体 · 历代修缮
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1100 仅为宋代现存主体的近似排序点。县志记隋开皇四年建桥，茅以升认为隋初创建可信而现存桥式尚待考证；罗哲文将现存桥身风格及雕刻判断为宋代遗存。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 漯河市临颍县
site_recommendation.lede: 一座低缓的主拱，两肩各开一个小腹拱。红石桥身与历代栏板共同记录了小商河上的营建和修补。

facts.label: 断代区分
facts.text: 桥的创建传统追溯至隋代；现存主体的建筑风格和饰面雕刻，罗哲文判断为宋代遗存。

facts.label: 结构形制
facts.text: 桥长 21.3 米、宽 6.45 米，一座圆弧形主拱左右各有一座小腹拱，为敞肩石拱桥。

facts.label: 历代修缮
facts.text: 1994—1995 年维修清理并归位多种构件，现有栏板、望柱包含宋、金、元、明、清时期遗物。
